# Outlook2Obsidian export configuration.
# Copy this file to "config.txt" (next to o2o-export.exe) and edit the values.
# Lines starting with '#' are comments. Format is Key=Value.

# Absolute folder the .md notes are written to. A trailing backslash is optional.
VaultPath=C:\Users\YourUsername\Obsidian\Vault\Emails\

# Prefix used in [[wikilinks]] for people, e.g. "@" -> [[@John Doe]].
PersonNameStartChar=@

# Prefix for generated file names, e.g. "Email_2026-06-27 1347 Subject.md".
FileNamePrefix=Email_

# Which folder to export:
#   Inbox | SentMail | Drafts | Outbox | DeletedItems | JunkEmail
# or a path under the default store, e.g. Inbox\Projects\ACME
FolderPath=Inbox

# Also export every subfolder of FolderPath (true/false).
Recurse=false

# Save attachments into an "attachments" subfolder and link them (true/false).
IncludeAttachments=false

# Wrap the email body in a fenced code block so Dataview/Templater code inside a
# (possibly hostile) message renders as text instead of executing when the note
# is opened in Obsidian. true = safer, false = nicer formatting.
WrapBodyInCodeBlock=false
